0.0: BAH! I fished up a book. A BOOK. All I ask for in life is to smoke my pipe, wear my hat, and be surrounded by hundreds of squirming fish. And I fish up a BOOK. Someone's playing a joke on me. Will you get rid of this non-squirming, non-wiggling book for me?

yes.0: I don't care what you do with it. Maybe take it to #eWiz the Librarian#k in the #bHelios Tower Library#k... He's quite the bookworm, I hear. Ah, worms... It's so cute how they wiggle.

no.0: But a school of Krappy will be swimming by soon, and I have to fish them up, and line them up in a row, and watch them squirm as I caress them one by one with the back of my hand!

1.0: Greetings, young one! I am #eWiz the Librarian#n, but you may call me Wiz the Reader, Shelver, and Protector of Books! Quickly! Do you have the #eMystical Book#k?! \r\n#L0##bEr, yeah, but how'd you know ab--#l\n#k
1.1: Because my Laser-sharp Mental Book Radar sensed the existence of the new book as soon as it was fished out of the sea! I came as quickly as I could! Oh, may I? Pretty please? Just let me TOUCH it...

yes.0: I sense... I sense... I sense that this book comes from a land far across the sea. It tells a story of a troubled time, and a faraway people. I got all of that just from brushing my fingers across the cover. Now, let me take this book back to my secret underground base-- I mean, the Helios Tower Library and study it some more. Gotta jet!

npc.0: Bah, take the book to  #eWiz the Librarian#k in the #bHelios Tower Library#k or something...

item.0: YOU HAVE SOMETHING I NEED. WHERE IS IT?!
